body:
Independent follow-up to the preserved W06 review `20261108T071757Z-w06-ten-unions-independent-metadata-v2` (authoritative YAML SHA256 `01a7f358f637ce22e8db311ca290c92e010fad757120f1ae43e89265b1742e32`). I verified all 670 manifest-listed proof files and independently matched the ten reviewed payloads to the active 37-candidate set. These are unapplied candidates, not owner or release approvals. Original reviews, source captures and histories remain immutable.

The active reconciled `Marine_Broth_2216.yaml` candidate SHA256 `88f51082e16410a972449bca01c009099c85f8c583803e277d6e21836f57f155` carries the supported component correction plus both findings below.

- **W06-TU-003** is the same active-rationale defect as W05-MEDIA-F01 already recorded in comment6718700948, now rebound to the combined candidate. `ontology_mapping.evidence[0].notes` still claims the broth and agar differ only by gelling agent. Preserve that statement historically but explicitly supersede it in current support. The [manufacturer manual](https://cdn.media.interlabdist.com.br/uploads/2021/01/Marine-2216-Agar-e-Broth.pdf), SHA256 `de2504598b1133074ba2239c045958e9a6564dc1b2a2d8f13ab4bac99233199f`, separately lists broth magnesium chloride5.9g/L and magnesium sulfate3.24g/L, versus agar magnesium chloride8.8g/L and sodium sulfate3.24g/L. Do not undo the source-supported broth transcription or infer scratch agar-minus-agar equivalence.
- **W06-TU-005** adds a precise minor qualification: `component_assertion.evidence[0].notes` should retain the manual's approximate-formula designation and its adjustment/supplementation-for-performance footnote. COMPLETE for all16 nominal printed dry-product inputs remains defensible. It does not mean exact every-lot chemical closure. Water remains reconstitution solvent; no guessed extra ingredient, forced PARTIAL status or form-specific salt mapping follows.

Keep literal generic Peptone and source-unspecified salt forms unresolved where appropriate. The wider Peptone identity dependencies (#1176), generic Marine Broth/Difco owner boundaries and the distinct Marine Agar issue remain separate. Preserve source-case histories, quantities and withheld claims. This comment adds current-union applicability and the nominal-formula wording to the existing issue; it does not request a duplicate issue or release approval.
